Parameter Description: Repeating substring, which is used to identify extracted internal standards (EIS), formally known as IDA, from compound name.
Repeating substring, which is used to identify non-extracted internal standards (NIS), formally known as IPS, from compound name.
Ending of compound names (column Component Name in SCIEX) for compounds and standards from the HRMS channel.
Repeating substring, which is used to identify calibration midpoint from sample name.
Name of the output files generated from the Code

To choose reference data from the calibration (midpoint) for QAQC, you can use data from initial calibration, or data from continuous calibration verification (CCV) 
Set parameter to calibration if you want to use data from initial calibration as reference. 
Set parameter to ccv if you want to use data from continuos calibration verification as reference.
